crossRefs.note: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except…
Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

people.name: Ziklag
people.line: A city given to David; originally Judah's, then Simeon's

translations.web: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag;
translations.bsb: After the death of Saul, David returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag two days.
translations.kjv: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;
translations.asv: And it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;
